name: Coriolis Ward prevents the next 1+level damage to target unit
notes: Coriolis Ward's element is WATER, so the starting champion's Subcards are patched with a real WATER champion (Spirit of Water) to unlock element access. The champion is level 0 by default, so the prevention amount resolves to the base 1+0=1. The 'Shifting Currents face West' bonus draw is tied to a separate facing-state subsystem and is out of scope.

rulesClauses: Prevent the next 1+LV damage that would be dealt to target unit this turn.
